headline: Ireh drops MV for 'So Good, Getting Better'
sub: Bright, upbeat new track premieres on 1theK
caption:
Ireh has dropped the music video for 'So Good, Getting Better' (좋아 좋아져).

The MV premiered on 1theK's official YouTube channel on Nov 26. Go give it a watch and tell us what you think!

📌 Source: 1theK official YouTube
